steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow adding vendors during event creation and keep Publish available.
Switch the default event type to RFQ and use the single-vendor lot award mode.
Enter the 200-character title under test.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the title field retains the full test value before submission.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Verify the requested product was selected.
Verify the product's automatically filled variant.
Verify the requested quantity.
Choose the specified delivery location.
Verify the delivery location selection.
Commit the 30-minute schedule requested by the case.
Invite one available QA test vendor because the case does not provide an exact vendor company name.
Publish the completed RFQ event.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Verify the published project page displays the title held for this event.
Return to the events list to verify list visibility.
Verify the events list rendered without an error.
Verify the published event appears in the list under the entered 200-character title.
